A.prompt: QA-sheet framing, 9 labels with short glosses (the bake-off prompt)

C.prompt: student-facing framing, 9 bare labels (held-out prompt, never used to choose a pose); strong model

method: blind forced choice of 1 of 9 labels, shuffled per call; 1 look x 24 reps per emotion per judge; encouraging judged on a 6-frame strip of a 2 s clip; bar >= 70% per emotion on 8 of 9 (proxy for E-T4)
